title: Philosophy & Ethics: Consolidation
goal: Combine neuter lo abstraction, deber vs deber de, mixed si-clauses, past-modal moral evaluation, and deductive markers in ethical argument.
grammar: review of neuter lo, deber vs deber de, mixed/gnomic si-clauses, debería/podría haber, and deductive markers

items: I can combine neuter lo abstraction and deber vs deber de to separate moral duties from inferences.
I can test ethical principles with mixed si-clauses and evaluate avoidable harm with debería haber, podría haber, and no tenía por qué.
I can build deductive chains with luego, de ahí que + subjunctive, and mid-clause por consiguiente.
